snippet.title: Peggle 2 Meet The Masters: Windy
snippet.description: Meet Windy the Fairy, Peggle 2's new master! Her Fairy Flock power transforms blue pegs into ferociously high-scoring purple pegs, and her pack has 10 levels, 10 trials, 30 objectives. Get her in the Peggle 2 store now! Peggle 2 — the sequel to one of the most addictive puzzle action games of all time — is exclusively first on Xbox One, and coming to Xbox 360 on May 7th.
